notes: Unlike the neighbouring verses, this one writes `הַשַּׂר`, so *captain* is that noun's own rendering rather than a supplied generic.

Two article morphemes stand in the phrase and the ASV writes one *the*, which stands before *fifth*; the article on the substantival ordinal takes it and the article on `הַשַּׂר` is the unrendered occurrence (rules 22 and 47).
